_about: The radio buff (the owner, 2026-10-27: respawn time -50 %, was -20 %; srp-026g/docs/notes/booster-buffs.md). The Radio (respawn_booster, a booster) works carried: its one default modification 1220 (drop_weight 0, no other item has it) adds respawn_time_modifier (index 60) to the kit's lists, and the respawn rule at a death (0x316AA0) makes the delay respawn_time x max(0, 1 + modifier 60), up to the 50 ms grid. The modifier -0.2 -> -0.5 (lobby_info with it): 8 s -> 4 s in Team Deathmatch, 10 s -> 5 s in the battery modes and Research (was 6.4 s and 8 s). The card keeps the game's line 124 "Respawn time" (lower is better): -0.20 -> -0.50, "Respawn time: -50%".
